title: Chinese Historical Society of America

services.name: Reserve a tour
services.desc: Enrich your knowledge of Chinese American and San Francisco history with one of our educational programs! Our tours and experiential programs provide in-depth explorations of the galleries at the Chinese Historical Society of America, and utilize the setting of Chinatown as an educational learning space. Public K-12 Groups: $5 / student plus $5 / chaperonePrivate K-12 Groups: $10 / student plus $10 / chaperoneCollege students & Adults: $15 / participant (regardless of group size) Learn more about the We Are Bruce Lee exhibit through a guided tour with one of our docents. Participants will learn more about Bruce Lee’s life, achievements, and impact, as well as better understand the stories
